title: Freescale Semiconductor engineers aboard MH370
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Freescale Semiconductor engineers aboard MH370, about 2014 at MH370 flight, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Among the documented passengers on the MH370 flight were 20 engineers from Freescale Semiconductor,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that among the passengers on MH370, a passenger flight that went missing in 2014, were 20 engineers from Freescale Semiconductor, a computer chip company. He brings it up in an episode about American scientists going missing, as a hint that the loss of these specialists may not have been chance.
